decisions.reason: As a recently launched safety-footwear line close to the firm's core business, the sunk development and market-introduction effort and the ease of blaming weaker traction on temporary pandemic-era conditions favor continuing it.

Although the electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe is somewhat more niche, it still fits the firm's announced occupational-footwear direction, so prior investment and commitment make management more likely to persist than exit quickly.

A general safety shoe series is highly central to a German leather-footwear producer's main business, so public launch commitment and sunk costs make withdrawal within the next year relatively unlikely.
